_comment: Known ctest outcomes on riscv64/openRuyi. All three drivers read this file via
ci_ctest_makeopts in scripts/lib/common.sh, which turns it into ctest options.
Each entry tags a ctest name as 'exclude' or 'flake':
exclude - deterministically wrong for a non-defect reason (version-sensitive
goldens, etc). Dropped via ctest -E. openRuyi's spec %check -E's the
flake   - fails non-deterministically (timing/resource races under -j, or a
transient network fault), not from a code bug. NOT excluded; the run
uses ctest --repeat until-pass so a retry clears them while a real
regression still fails. Any flake entry turns --repeat on for the
whole ctest run, not just that test.
Real code bugs are NOT listed here - they are carried as fork-patches (see README).
'test' is matched as a ctest-name regex (anchored ^...$ by the script).

failures.reason: grafana panel goldens drift with the prometheus version; not a defect
alert-rules golden (tests_alerts/test_alerts.yml) drifts with the prometheus version; not a defect
promtool packaged but not baked into the build image yet; `promtool check rules` fails with ENOENT
failures.ref: re-enable once promtool is baked into the build image

failures.reason: jsonnet-bundler-build.sh git-clones github.com/jsonnet-bundler/jsonnet-bundler at test time with no retry; a proxy/github hiccup fails the clone and takes its dependent run-tox-jsonnet-check down as Not Run
failures.ref: only ctest still reaching the network during %check
